title: Varying Kibibits
statementMd:
You are given $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$. Denote this list of integers as $*T*$.

Let $*f*(*L*)$ be a function that takes in a non-empty list of integers $*L*$.

The function will output another integer as follows:

- First, all integers in $*L*$ are padded with leading zeros so they are all the same length as the maximum length number in $*L*$.
- We will construct a string where the $*i*$-th character is the minimum of the $*i*$-th character in padded input numbers.
- The output is the number representing the string interpreted in base 10.

For example $*f*(10, 9) = 0$, $*f*(123, 321) = 121$, $*f*(530, 932, 81) = 30$.

Define the function

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34a509f74cbc53a043710b4c2baed78d6aeb4c3e.png)

Here,

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0241ed64f7f754d714cf9b2cef41ae3ac7b2cb35.png)

denotes a subsequence.

In other words, $*G*(*x*)$ is the sum of squares of sum of elements of nonempty subsequences of $*T*$ that evaluate to $*x*$ when plugged into $*f*$ modulo $1 000 000 007$, then multiplied by $*x*$. The last multiplication is not modded.

You would like to compute $*G*(0), *G*(1), ..., *G*(999 999)$. To reduce the output size, print the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8758e4ee150415656efb78a88beae1c6d7f1c5bb.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) denotes the bitwise XOR operator.

## Input

The first line contains the integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$) — the size of list $*T*$.

The next line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers, $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 999 999$) — the elements of the list.

## Output

Output a single integer, the answer to the problem.

## Note

For the first sample, the nonzero values of $*G*$ are $*G*(121) = 144 611 577$, $*G*(123) = 58 401 999$, $*G*(321) = 279 403 857$, $*G*(555) = 170 953 875$. The bitwise XOR of these numbers is equal to $292 711 924$.

For example, ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/53a1c46c7cd2d3d56e89fe99af6328601758b327.png), since the subsequences $[123]$ and $[123, 555]$ evaluate to $123$ when plugged into $*f*$.

For the second sample, we have ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/330ab8a9387bb33a82877190f4439f4e9ccd8e92.png)

For the last sample, we have ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0e0eeb7662af22bf04ea1a2ea669b162d53ad7ba.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4f42013cbab8c31325f2cf28b60aa2ccc1cf89d3.png) is the binomial coefficient.
statementZhMd:
你将得到 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。将这个整数列表记为 $*T*$。

令 $*f*(*L*)$ 为一个接收非空整数列表 $*L*$ 的函数。

该函数的输出是另一个整数，具体过程如下：

- 首先，在 $*L*$ 中所有整数的前面补上前导零，使它们的长度都与 $*L*$ 中长度最大的数相同。
- 构造一个字符串，其中第 $*i*$ 个字符为补零后输入数字的第 $*i*$ 个字符中的最小值。
- 将该字符串按十进制解释后得到的数字作为输出。

例如，$*f*(10, 9) = 0$、$*f*(123, 321) = 121$、$*f*(530, 932, 81) = 30$。

定义函数

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/34a509f74cbc53a043710b4c2baed78d6aeb4c3e.png)

其中，

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0241ed64f7f754d714cf9b2cef41ae3ac7b2cb35.png)

表示一个子序列。

换句话说，$*G*(*x*)$ 是所有非空子序列的元素和的平方之和：这些子序列代入 $*f*$ 后的结果为 $*x*$。该平方和对 $1 000 000 007$ 取模后，再乘以 $*x*$。最后一次乘法不取模。

你需要计算 $*G*(0), *G*(1), ..., *G*(999 999)$。为了减少输出量，请输出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8758e4ee150415656efb78a88beae1c6d7f1c5bb.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示按位异或运算符。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1 000 000$）——列表 $*T*$ 的大小。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 999 999$）——列表中的元素。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即题目的答案。

## 说明

对于第一个样例，$*G*$ 的非零值为 $*G*(121) = 144 611 577$、$*G*(123) = 58 401 999$、$*G*(321) = 279 403 857$、$*G*(555) = 170 953 875$。这些数的按位异或结果为 $292 711 924$。

例如，![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/53a1c46c7cd2d3d56e89fe99af6328601758b327.png)，因为子序列 $[123]$ 和 $[123, 555]$ 代入 $*f*$ 后的结果都是 $123$。

对于第二个样例，有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/330ab8a9387bb33a82877190f4439f4e9ccd8e92.png)

对于最后一个样例，有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0e0eeb7662af22bf04ea1a2ea669b162d53ad7ba.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4f42013cbab8c31325f2cf28b60aa2ccc1cf89d3.png) 是二项式系数。
